title: Colonel Coleman's B-25 UFO encounter over Alabama

tellings.quote: that led me to to Colonel William Coleman who had that dramatic encounter uh with UFO and B-55 over Alabama,

plain: In the 1950s, a colonel named William Coleman is said to have had a dramatic encounter with a UFO while flying a B-25 bomber over Alabama. The documentary filmmaker James Fox mentions it in passing, saying his research led him to Coleman, and he does not describe the encounter itself; on the show he calls the plane a "B-55".
